steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Ensure vendors can be added during event creation as required by the case.
Switch the event type from the default to RFQ and retain whole-lot awarding.
Provide the mandatory event title required for publishing.
Apply the available RFQ pricing template so the product sheet is created.
Confirm that the template was applied before editing the sheet.
Add the specified product to the RFQ sheet.
Fill the remaining mandatory pricing-sheet fields so the event can proceed.
Enter the very large quantity in the first line item and tab out of the cell.
Verify that the sheet retained the large quantity without marking it as an error.
Select the required delivery location for the line item.
Add one available QA vendor so the RFQ can be published.
Confirm that publishing reached a real project page.
Confirm that publication did not produce an application error.
